changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment:
Dashboards 403 (pfSense Firewall), 404 (Network Traffic NetFlow) and 405 (GCP Activity) were seeded by changeset 20261012002 with dv_order / dv_width / dv_height / dv_top / dv_left set, but dv_grid_info was left NULL. Every code path that does JSON.parse(visualization.gridInfo) (utm-dashboard-grid.calcGridHeight, dashboard-resolver, dashboard-create) threw on those rows, so opening those dashboards in the editor / customize-export crashed with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'y')" and "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'slice')".
The seed also stored dv_height = 529.2 (a pixel value equal to 8 gridster rows), but the intended items are 4 rows tall (dv_top steps 0,4,8,12, which only tiles without overlap at 4 rows). Backfill dv_grid_info from the numeric columns using the dashboard gridster pixel scale (full-width item 2012px = 30 cols -> 67.07px/col; 4 rows x 65px -> 259.6px): cols = GREATEST(1, ROUND(dv_width / 67.07)) -- 529.2->8, 933.6->14, 2012->30 rows = 4 -- 2 x 4-row items per 8-row band x = dv_left -- already gridster units y = dv_top -- already gridster units id = uuid (gridster item identity) and normalize dv_height to 259.6 (4 rows) so the stored geometry is internally consistent. This yields bands 0-4, 4-8, 8-12, 12-16 with no overlap, eliminating the gridster "Can't be placed in the bounds" warnings.
Idempotent: the dv_height fix only touches the exact legacy value (529.2); the grid_info backfill only touches rows with NULL/empty dv_grid_info. Re-running is a no-op once corrected.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE utm_dashboard_visualization SET dv_height = 259.6 WHERE id_dashboard IN (403, 404, 405) AND dv_height = 529.2;

UPDATE utm_dashboard_visualization SET dv_grid_info = json_build_object( 'cols', GREATEST(1, ROUND(dv_width / 67.07)), 'id', gen_random_uuid()::text, 'rows', 4, 'x', dv_left, 'y', dv_top )::text WHERE id_dashboard IN (403, 404, 405) AND (dv_grid_info IS NULL OR dv_grid_info = '' OR dv_grid_info = 'null');
